scientific_integrity.historical_priority: Full text of the 2014 Discrete Applied Mathematics paper on Abelian borders could not be inspected. The literature comparison cannot establish absolute novelty.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No characterization of all weights or all alphabet sizes; no claim that known shortest examples were discovered here.
scientific_integrity.scope: Binary linear words; equivalence for minimum symbol multiplicity <=3; complete discrepancy classification for exactly four ones.
scientific_integrity.verification: Proof covers infinite lengths; supplementary direct finite enumeration tests 36,455 sparse cases, 80,730 weight-four words, and generating coefficients through n=120.

title: The four-marker threshold separating ordinary and Abelian borders
